program:
app "Trip budget" plane mint
table trip_cost what text, amount money, category pick Hotel|Food|Transport|Tickets|Shopping
state m date = today
let spent = sum(trip_cost.amount month of m)
setting budget money = 120000 "Monthly budget"
monthnav m
"Safe to spend" round(max(budget - spent, 0) / (monthdays(today) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day" faint
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
form trip_cost
daybars last 7 days, sum(trip_cost.amount on it)
share trip_cost month of m by category, sum(it.amount), it.key
list trip_cost month of m by day
describe:
Trip budget, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- trip cost: what: text; amount: money; category: one of Hotel, Food, Transport, Tickets, Shopping. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 120000.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of trip cost in the month of m.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.
Shows:
- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- text: "Safe to spend", the larger of budget minus spent and 0 divided by the result of the number of days in the month of today minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day".
- text: "Over budget by" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "Left to spend", budget minus spent without its sign.
- spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
- a form to add a trip cost.
- a bar chart of the total amount of trip cost on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
- bars that compare the total amount of the item across group of trip cost entries in the month of m by category.
- a list of trip cost in the month of m by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: mention the last feature first

app "52 weeks" target mint

program:
app "Tic tac toe" board mint
table move game num, cell num 1..9, mark pick X|O
setting cur num = 1 "Game"
let n = count(move where game = cur)
let turn = if(n % 2 = 0, "X", "O")
let win(m text) = count([123, 456, 789, 147, 258, 369, 159, 357], count(move where game = cur and mark = m and (cell = floor(it / 100) or cell = floor(it / 10) % 10 or cell = it % 10)) = 3) > 0
let xw = win("X")
let ow = win("O")
if xw or ow
  if(xw, "X", "O") "wins!" big
else
  if(n = 9, "Draw", turn) if(n = 9, "", "to play") big
grid 3 gap 1
  each 1..9 as c
    if count(move where game = cur and cell = c) = 0 and not xw and not ow
      box height 80 radius 8 fill soft tap add move game = cur, cell = c, mark = turn
    else
      box height 80 radius 8 fill surface
        last(move.mark where game = cur and cell = c) big align center
button "New game" tap set cur = cur + 1
describe:
Tic tac toe, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- move: game: number; cell: number, 1 to 9; mark: one of X, O. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Game": number, starts at 1.
Works out:
- n is how many move entries where game is cur.
- turn is "X" when n leaves over when divided by 2 is 0, otherwise "O".
- xw is the result of how many of 123, 456, 789, 147, 258, 369, 159, 357 have how many move entries where game is cur and mark is "X" and the result of cell is the value divided by 100 rounded down or cell is the value divided by 10 rounded down leaves over when divided by 10 or cell is the value leaves over when divided by 10 is 3 is more than 0.
- ow is the result of how many of 123, 456, 789, 147, 258, 369, 159, 357 have how many move entries where game is cur and mark is "O" and the result of cell is the value divided by 100 rounded down or cell is the value divided by 10 rounded down leaves over when divided by 10 or cell is the value leaves over when divided by 10 is 3 is more than 0.
Shows:
- if xw or ow:
  - text: "X" when xw, otherwise "O", "wins!".
- otherwise:
  - text: "Draw" when n is 9, otherwise turn, "" when n is 9, otherwise "to play".
- a grid of 3 columns:
  - for each number from 1 to 9:
    - if how many move entries where game is cur and cell is the number is 0 and not xw and not ow:
      - a group; a tap adds a move with game set to cur, cell set to the number, mark set to turn:
    - otherwise:
      - text: the latest mark of move where game is cur and cell is the number.
- a button "New game"; a tap sets cur to cur plus 1.

fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words

program:
app "Treasure hunt" map plum
table clue text text
state step num = 1
let n = count(clue)
each clue sort at as c
  if index = step - 1
    stack card gap 1
      "Clue" step "of" n faint
      c.text head
row gap 1
  each 1..n
    icon if(it <= step, "star", "minus")
button "Found it, next clue" tap set step = min(step + 1, n)
button "Start again" tap set step = 1
form clue, "Add clue"
describe:
Treasure hunt, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- clue: text: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- n is how many clue entries.
Remembers while you use it: step, starting at 1.

- for each clue sorted by at:
  - if its position is step minus 1:
    - text: "Clue", step, "of", n.
    - text: the text of the clue.
- for each number from 1 to n:
  - an icon.
- a button "Found it, next clue"; a tap sets step to the smaller of step plus 1 and n.
- a button "Start again"; a tap sets step to 1.
